== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[Physical Choke (V) (Errata)]]: the region (156, 52, 364, 116) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[Physical Choke (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d6a6c8357ee1271111a23c1a199474dae7c25313/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/physicalchoke.gif Holotable commit d6a6c83] (2024-07-23). The matching before crop is [[:File:V23-D-physicalchoke-2024-07-23-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Physical Choke (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/physicalchoke.gif commit 335d47f]) and [[Physical Choke (V) (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d6a6c8357ee1271111a23c1a199474dae7c25313/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/physicalchoke.gif commit d6a6c83]).
